name: zig_check
description: zig_check must run zig ast-check on a single file and report the verdict. The file asserted is src/main.zig, which the fmt and build gates keep permanently parseable, so the expectation is content-independent: a known-good file must come back ok regardless of what the file says that week. Exercises the exec_allow path (zig) with an empty fs_prefixes (the file is an exec argument, not a ck_fs_* path).
prompt: Use the zig_check tool on file "src/main.zig" without the fmt option. Look at the tool's JSON result and reply with only the value of its "ok" field: true or false.
